(pha)༄༅/ /lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/dpal he ru ka la phyag

tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu stong pa'i bdag nyid can// ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dngos// he ru ka dpal la btud de// de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gnas dben par stan bde bar bsdad la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du bde mchog bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon gyi cha la tshes gcig gi zla bas brgyan zhing mtshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang bas u ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ skra grol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/

rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs shing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka mnyam par sbyor zhing ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom mo// de nas thugs ka nas sangs rgyas rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spros nas/ sems can thams cad lhan skyes kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsams nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dpal he ru ka 'ba' zhig yin la/ de dag thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'o snyam du bsams nas de la yid mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod pas lus skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs drang por byas nas/ lte ba'i nang du a shad kyi rnam pa lta bu phra ba rtsub pa ngar dang ldan pa gcig bsams la/ de'i nus pas rang gi sdig pa dang nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsregs/ spyi bo dang snying ga nas byang sems 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu phab pa rtsa dbu ma nas brgyud/ des lus thams cad khyab pas lus thams cad bde bas gang*/ bde bas rtog pa thams cad 'gags nas bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /goms na drod dang bde ba dang*/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// //de nas bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ snying gi nang du padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar bam̐ dmar po bsams la/ hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba 'od kyi rnam pa byung ba rang gi zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon/ yab kyi rdo rje'i sbu gur zhugs shing 'khor bas sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug par bsam zhing*/

oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi dang*/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes yab yum gyi sngags sbrel ba'am so so ba ci nus bzlas so// bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// //khrus byed pa'i tshe rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas rigs lngas rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang ba bdag gi spyi bo nas blugs pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs par bsam zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la khrus bya'o// khrus kyi rnal 'byor ro// de nas mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma bshams la/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grihna grihna hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grihnā pa ya grihnā pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wāṃ bi dyā rā dzā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas ma dag pa bsang*/ gong du brjod pa'i swa bhā ba'i sngags kyis stong par bsams/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par bskyed nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇḍal zhes kun la sbyar la/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod nas/ de'i spyan sngar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag tu bdag nyid skyabs su mchi// he ru ka dpal sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*// zhes lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sdom pa blang ngo*// de nas gtor ma sbyangs la/

sum̐ bha'i sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ āḥlas khams gsum khyab pa'i thod pa chen po'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar bskyed/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dpyes su bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ zhes brjod pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ chos skyong srung mas bskor ba spyan drangs nas/ de rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra ā ralli ho/ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bya ba lngas dbul/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma'i mgron dang*/ tshogs kyi zhing badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo// mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// kha zas la longs spyod pa'i tshe zas de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rang lhar gsal gdab/ lte ba'i gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du/ snying gar bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ lto bar chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i tshogs rnams dmigs nas/ de rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ lag pa g.yon pas longs spyad do// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// //de nas spyod lam ni ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang dang snang ba thams cad lhar gsal gdab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas brtan par byas nas lus kyi bya ba phyag rgya/ ngag tu brjod pa sngags/ sems kyi bsam pa ting nge 'dzin du bsam par bya zhing*/ thams cad du 'khor gsum du zhen pa dang bral bar bya'o// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// //rnal 'byor pa rig ma bsten pa yin na/ snyoms 'jug gi rnal 'byor ni rig ma dbang bskur ba thob pa la rung gi ma thob pa la mi rung ngo*// de'ang skad cig gis rang he ru ka dang*/

rig ma rdo rje phag mor dmigs la/ yum gyi bha ga padma as mtshan pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bskyed la/ gnyis ka'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod snyam du bsams nas/ chags pa dang bral ba'i tshul gyis bsten par bya'o// snyoms 'jug gi rnal 'byor ro// //nub mor nyal ba'i tshe rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad rang la bsdu/ rang snying ga'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ stong par yal ba'i ngang la gnyid log go /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro// //nang par ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis rang he ru ka'i skur langs la/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad lha'i skur gyur par bltas la ldang ngo*// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ro// //nyin zhag phrugs gcig gis bya ba 'dis yongs su rdzogs par byas na myur du rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// skal ldan gdul bya rnams kyi phyir// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i tshul// bla ma'i drin gyis gang rtogs pa// gzhan gyi don du bdag gis sbyar// de las byung ba'i dge ba des// 'gro kun zab mo'i lam zhugs nas// sku gsum ye shes lnga bdag nyid// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog /'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gis brgyan pa/ yan lag bcu pa zhes bya ba 'di/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pa zhes bya ba la/ yu gur gyi yul du skyes pa'i bande mngon pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa/ saṃ gha mi tra zhes bya bas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ shing mo yos bu'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po la rgya'i yul the ler zhes bya bar sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
